dim_resolution.action: dict scan country_code, find code for '[us]' as us_code; build flat_hash_set<int32_t> non_us_cn_ids by scanning country_code.bin where code != 0 && code != us_code. Also keep id->name_offset mapping (id is dense identity, use offsets array directly).
single scan over info.off/info.dat: capture it1_id where info=='countries' and it2_id where info=='rating'
scan keyword.off/keyword.dat for 4 literals ('murder','murder-in-title','blood','violence'); build flat_hash_set<int32_t> kw_ids
scan kind.off/kind.dat for 'movie','episode'; build flat_hash_set<int32_t> kt_ids
no predicate; skip (ct.id present on mc.company_type_id is guaranteed valid; trivial join)

filters.predicate: note non-empty AND NOT memmem(note,'(USA)') AND memmem(note,'(200') AND non_us_cn_ids.contains(company_id)

join_order.notes: Use offsets_only index; for each surviving title, iterate mk rows and check kw_ids. Bail on first match.

join_order.build: title rows that have qualifying mk
join_order.strategy: offset_index_scan with info_type_id == it2_id and string < '7.0'
join_order.notes: Must find >=1 satisfying row; capture mi_idx.info for running MIN.

join_order.strategy: offset_index_scan with info_type_id == it1_id and info_set.contains
offset_index_scan with two memmem on note and non_us_cn_ids probe
join_order.notes: For each qualifying mc row, capture cn.name (via cn id->name lookup) and update running MINs.

data_structures.running_min: three string_view-style minimums (cn.name, mi_idx.info, t.title), each thread-local then reduced

parallelism.reduction: thread-local running MINs reduced at end via lex compare

aggregation: scalar_min (3 running minimums, no group key)
evaluation_order_per_title: 1. title.production_year > 2009 (cheap int filter; skips ~90% of titles, tighter than Q22a's >2008)
3. mk range scan -> kw_ids.contains(keyword_id) (cheapest fact, ~1.8 rows/title avg)
4. mi_idx range scan -> info_type_id==it2_id and string < '7.0' (capture info for MIN)
5. mi range scan -> info_type_id==it1_id and info IN set
6. mc range scan -> note memmem checks + non_us_cn_ids.contains(company_id) (capture cn.name for MIN)
